summary: Pre-market, 2026-09-08. The composite risk score rose 0.05 on the day to 42.79, with a 1-week trend of +0.73 and a 1-month trend of -0.4, and the risk level stays caution under a goldilocks regime at model confidence 0.9121. The move is small but the composition is not: the macro block holds at 62.25 with the 10Y real rate at 2.42 (98.15th percentile), the 10Y at 4.77 and the 2Y at 4.34, while internal breadth thinned to 0.6194 and the dollar firmed to 118.7479. Overnight news priced physical capacity rather than demand: Wistron, an Nvidia supplier, launched a 1.5B dollar global share sale and its shares fell; Apple is reported to have signed rare 3 to 5 year NAND contracts that may carry no price ceiling; Changxin Memory signalled DRAM supply stays tight; and H100 rental rates were quoted 22% higher quarter on quarter at 3.28 dollars per hour. The theme tape agrees - semiconductor equipment +5.1904, AI infrastructure +3.882 and semiconductors +3.5165 against AI software -3.8292, enterprise software -2.2253 and autos -5.9223 - so capital is paying for capacity and withholding it from software. Credit and volatility still refuse to confirm stress: HY OAS 2.65 sits at the 3.81st percentile, IG OAS 0.81, VIX 14.32 and realised volatility 8.1061. The tension to watch is that the buffer is quietly eroding while policy is still priced as a hike - reserves 2894531, reverse repo 0.675 at the 4.74th percentile for a 90.52 risk score, FedWatch implying 3.935 against an effective funds rate of 3.63 - with PPI on 2026-09-10 and CPI on 2026-09-11 inside that window. In A-shares the close was split, 5 of 11 names higher, led by 001309.SZ +3.1784 and 300475.SZ +1.5889, with 002156.SZ -1.4032 and 688008.SH -1.097 the laggards. Note that the Chinese-language wires in this feed arrive via RSSHub relays and are second-hand aggregation.

top_risk_drivers.claim: Restrictive real rates keep the macro block the largest contributor: the 10Y real rate is 2.42 at the 98.15th percentile, with the 10Y at 4.77 and the 2Y at 4.34, holding the macro dimension at 62.25 even as its trend turns lower.

The liquidity buffer is eroding under the surface: reserves fell to 2894531 and reverse repo drained to 0.675, a 4.74th-percentile reading worth a 90.52 risk score, while SOFR at 3.66 sits above an effective funds rate of 3.63.

Policy is still priced as a hike into an inflation week: FedWatch implies 3.935 against an effective funds rate of 3.63, with PPI on 2026-09-10 and CPI on 2026-09-11, while the 5Y5Y breakeven is unmoved at 2.33 and the 10Y breakeven at 2.35.
Breadth is thinning while leadership concentrates: the share above the MA200 fell to 0.6194 with new highs at 0.0194 and new lows at 0.0129, and small-cap relative strength at 0.6731.

The AI trade has split into capacity versus software: semiconductor equipment +5.1904, AI infrastructure +3.882 and networking +2.8242 against AI software -3.8292, enterprise software -2.2253 and consumer electronics -1.9335, with autos the worst theme at -5.9223.

supporting_signals.claim: Credit refuses to confirm any stress: HY OAS is 2.65 at the 3.81st percentile and IG OAS 0.81, holding the liquidity and credit dimension at 36.37.
Volatility is suppressed on both measures: VIX 14.32 at the 16.27th percentile and realised volatility 8.1061, for a volatility dimension score of 13.34.
The capacity complex still leads: semiconductors +3.5165, semis leaders +2.9588, data centers +1.8788 and industrial automation +1.2232, with MU +6.0982 and AMD +4.6935 on the tape.
The price trend is intact: 8.1495 above the MA200, 3-month momentum 4.4255 and a 52-week drawdown of only -0.9886.
Compute demand is being priced up, not down: H100 rental rates were quoted 22% higher quarter on quarter at 3.28 dollars per hour, with Micron at 1016.59, Nvidia at 230.36 and AVGO +0.2072.

contradicting_signals.claim: Internal breadth keeps deteriorating: 0.6194 above the MA200 with new highs at only 0.0194, and the equity structure dimension rising to 46.5.
The software and consumer complex is being sold: AI software -3.8292, robotics -2.7, enterprise software -2.2253, digital advertising -1.5423 and fintech -1.3291.
Cross-asset confirmation is only partial at 0.625 and crypto is not confirming: BTC 78731.0, ETH 2487.28 and SOL 103.57, with BTC dominance at 0.589256.
The dollar is firming again - broad index 118.7479, EURUSD 1.1598, USDJPY 159.97 and USDCNH 6.726 - which tightens conditions into the inflation prints.
Labour still supports the hike pricing: payrolls 162.0 against a prior 21.0, unemployment 4.1, initial claims 206000 and continuing claims 1779000, with participation 61.6.

what_changed_today: Risk score +0.05 on the day to 42.79; the 1-week trend is +0.73 and the 1-month trend -0.4. Risk level caution, regime goldilocks, model confidence 0.9121.
Front end eased again: 2Y 4.39 to 4.34, 10Y 4.79 to 4.77 and the 10Y real rate 2.45 to 2.42, leaving the curve positive.
The dollar firmed across the board: broad index 118.3583 to 118.7479, EURUSD 1.1654 to 1.1598, USDJPY 159.26 to 159.97, USDCNH 6.7198 to 6.726.
Liquidity drained further: reverse repo 0.702 to 0.675 and reserves 2924936 to 2894531, while the Fed balance sheet rose to 6737204 and SOFR ticked to 3.66.

Overnight flow priced capacity: Wistron's 1.5B dollar share sale, Apple's reported 3 to 5 year NAND contracts possibly without a price ceiling, Changxin Memory flagging tight DRAM supply, and H100 rentals 22% higher at 3.28 dollars per hour.

Sell-side raised the bar: HSBC lifted its 2026 year-end S&P 500 target to 8100 from 7650 and its 2026 Brent forecast to 90 dollars from 80 dollars with the fourth quarter at 95 dollars; Citi raised its 2030 server CPU TAM to 237B dollars from 137B dollars.
A-share close was split: 5 of 11 names higher, 001309.SZ +3.1784 and 300475.SZ +1.5889 leading, against 002156.SZ -1.4032, 688008.SH -1.097, 000021.SZ -0.8501 and 600584.SH -0.5797.
Inflation data is now the binding event: PPI on 2026-09-10 and CPI on 2026-09-11, with ADBE earnings on 2026-09-10 and FDX earnings on 2026-09-17.

Whether HY OAS 2.65 and VIX 14.32 stay anchored; they are the two readings that have refused to confirm stress all year.

bull_case.title: Capacity bid holds and inflation behaves
points: Credit stays benign: HY OAS 2.65 at the 3.81st percentile and IG OAS 0.81 leave no funding stress to transmit.
Volatility stays suppressed at VIX 14.32 and realised volatility 8.1061, so dips get bought rather than deleveraged.
Semiconductor equipment +5.1904, AI infrastructure +3.882 and semiconductors +3.5165 keep leadership narrow but positive.
A soft CPI on 2026-09-11 pulls the FedWatch-implied 3.935 back toward the effective funds rate of 3.63.
Breadth at 0.6194 stabilises rather than rolling toward the new-lows ratio of 0.0129.

base_case.title: Range-bound caution while the tape rotates
points: Risk score holds near 42.79 with the risk level at caution under a goldilocks regime.
Capacity themes lead and software lags: semiconductor equipment +5.1904 against AI software -3.8292.
The dollar stays firm near 118.7479 and reserves near 2894531 - a slow drain, not a shock.
PPI on 2026-09-10 and CPI on 2026-09-11 move the front end but not the HY OAS at 2.65.

bear_case.title: A hot CPI meets an empty buffer
points: A hot CPI on 2026-09-11 against a FedWatch-implied 3.935 pushes the 10Y above 4.77 and the real rate above 2.42.
Reverse repo at 0.675 and reserves at 2894531 leave no shock absorber if funding tightens.
Breadth at 0.6194 with new highs at 0.0194 means the index is carried by very few names.
HY OAS 2.65 sits at the 3.81st percentile - the only direction left is wider, and it gaps.
Autos -5.9223 and AI software -3.8292 say the demand side is already rolling over.
